actions.title: Record a transaction
actions.description: Records completed income or an expense. Changes the cash balance.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount in rupees, greater than zero

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date the money moved (not in the future)

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Account the money moved through (defaults to the default account)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How it moved: UPI, IMPS, NEFT, Cheque, ATM… (free text, up to 30 characters)

actions.title: Edit a transaction
actions.description: Changes a manual transaction. Balances, budgets and analytics update automatically.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount in rupees, greater than zero

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date the money moved (not in the future)

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Account the money moved through (defaults to the default account)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How it moved: UPI, IMPS, NEFT, Cheque, ATM… (free text, up to 30 characters)

actions.title: Delete a transaction
actions.description: Permanently removes a manual transaction and reverses its effect on balances.

actions.title: Create a category
actions.description: Adds a custom income or expense category. Does not move money.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Category name, 2–30 characters, unique per type

fields.name: isEssential
fields.description: Essential spending (used for the emergency-fund suggestion)

actions.title: Edit a category
actions.description: Renames or restyles a category. System categories only allow icon and colour changes.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Category name, 2–30 characters, unique per type

fields.name: isEssential
fields.description: Essential spending (used for the emergency-fund suggestion)

actions.title: Archive or restore a category
actions.description: Hides a category from pickers (or restores it). Past transactions keep their category.

actions.title: Delete a category
actions.description: Permanently removes a category that no transaction, budget or subscription uses.

actions.title: Create a budget
actions.description: Sets a spending limit for an expense category. Budgets hold no money; spending is derived from transactions.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Monthly spending limit in rupees, greater than zero

actions.title: Edit a budget
actions.description: Changes a budget's category, monthly limit or warning level. Earlier months keep the limit they had.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Monthly spending limit in rupees, greater than zero

actions.title: Pause or resume a budget
actions.description: A paused budget keeps its settings but stops tracking warnings and alerts.

fields.name: paused
fields.description: true to pause, false to resume

actions.title: Delete a budget
actions.description: Removes a spending limit. Transactions and balances are not affected.

actions.title: Track money owed
actions.description: Records an obligation between you and someone else. Does not change your cash balance.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: iOwe = I must pay; owedToMe = I will receive

fields.name: linkedUserId
fields.description: FiNN user to share with; the item then also appears in their account. Find ids with the user directory.

actions.title: Split money owed
actions.description: Splits one bill between several people: equally, by exact amounts, percentages, shares or adjustments. Creates one item per person. Does not change your cash balance.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: owedToMe = I paid and they owe me their shares; iOwe = I owe each person their share

fields.name: total
fields.description: Whole bill in rupees, your own share included when includeMe

fields.name: method
fields.description: equally; exact (value = rupees, must add up to total); percent (value = %, must add up to 100); shares (value = whole parts); adjustment (value = rupees added (+) or taken off (−) an equal share)

fields.name: includeMe
fields.description: You were part of the bill too; your share is not owed. Only with owedToMe

fields.name: myValue
fields.description: Your own value when includeMe (same unit as people[].value)

fields.name: people
fields.description: List of {counterparty, linkedUserId?, value?}, 2 to 20 people, you not included

actions.title: Edit money owed
actions.description: Edits the details of a pending payment. The original amount cannot go below what was already settled.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: iOwe = I must pay; owedToMe = I will receive

fields.name: linkedUserId
fields.description: FiNN user to share with; the item then also appears in their account. Find ids with the user directory.

actions.title: Settle money owed
actions.description: Records a full or partial settlement. Creates the matching cash movement once (never twice).

fields.name: pendingId
fields.description: Exact pending payment id. Use pending.resolve to find it by name; never guess.

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Account the money moved through (defaults to the default account)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How it moved (free text, up to 30 characters)

fields.name: recordCashMovement
fields.description: Create the matching cash transaction (default true)

actions.title: Write off money owed
actions.description: Marks the remaining amount as no longer expected. Recorded settlements are kept.

actions.title: Delete pending item
actions.description: Removes an item created by mistake. Items with settlements must be written off instead.

actions.title: Add a loan
actions.description: Adds a borrowed or lent loan (EMI or interest-only). Optionally records the disbursement as cash.

fields.name: recordDisbursement
fields.description: Record the disbursement as a cash movement

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Account the disbursement moved through (defaults to the default account)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How the disbursement moved (free text, up to 30 characters)

actions.title: Edit a loan
actions.description: Edits loan details. Terms are locked once payments exist.

fields.name: recordDisbursement
fields.description: Record the disbursement as a cash movement

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Account the disbursement moved through (defaults to the default account)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How the disbursement moved (free text, up to 30 characters)

actions.title: Record a loan payment
actions.description: Records an EMI, an interest payment, or a principal prepayment. Interest due is paid first; the rest reduces principal.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount paid (or received for lent loans)

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Account the payment moved through (defaults to the default account)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How it moved (free text, up to 30 characters)

fields.name: recordCashMovement
fields.description: Create the matching cash transaction (default true)

actions.title: Delete a loan
actions.description: Removes a loan added by mistake. Loans with payments cannot be deleted.

actions.title: Add a subscription
actions.description: Tracks a recurring cost. Upcoming charges are projections; nothing is paid automatically.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount per cycle in rupees, greater than zero

actions.title: Edit a subscription
actions.description: Changes a subscription. Past payments are not affected.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount per cycle in rupees, greater than zero

actions.title: Pause, resume or cancel a subscription
actions.description: Changes whether a subscription counts towards your monthly commitment. Past payments are kept.

actions.title: Mark a subscription as paid
actions.description: Records one renewal payment as an expense and moves the next due date forward by one cycle. Each cycle can be paid only once.

fields.name: cycleDate
fields.description: Due date of the cycle being paid (defaults to next due date)

fields.name: date
fields.description: Payment date, not in the future (defaults to the due date)

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount paid (defaults to the subscription amount)

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Account paid from (defaults to the subscription account, then the default account)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How it was paid (free text, up to 30 characters)

actions.title: Skip a renewal
actions.description: Moves the next due date forward by one cycle without recording a payment (for example a free month or a waived charge).

fields.name: cycleDate
fields.description: Due date of the cycle being skipped

actions.title: Delete a subscription
actions.description: Removes a subscription. Payments already recorded stay in your transactions.

actions.title: Create a savings goal
actions.description: Creates a goal. An optional starting amount is earmarked from available cash (not spent).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Goal name, up to 50 characters, unique among active goals

fields.name: initialAllocation
fields.description: Amount to earmark now (create only; ignored on update)

actions.title: Edit a goal
actions.description: Changes goal details. The saved amount only changes through contributions and withdrawals.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Goal name, up to 50 characters, unique among active goals

fields.name: initialAllocation
fields.description: Amount to earmark now (create only; ignored on update)

actions.title: Add money to a goal
actions.description: Earmarks available cash for a goal. Not an expense; net worth is unchanged.

actions.title: Withdraw from a goal
actions.description: Releases earmarked money back to available cash. Not income.

actions.title: Archive or restore a goal
actions.description: Hides a goal from the active list (or restores it). Earmarked money is unaffected.

actions.title: Delete a goal
actions.description: Deletes a goal. Any saved amount is released back to available cash.

actions.title: Set up the emergency fund plan
actions.description: Sets essential monthly expenses and the months of cover to aim for. No money moves.

actions.title: Add to the emergency fund
actions.description: Earmarks available cash for emergencies. Not an expense; net worth is unchanged.

actions.title: Withdraw from the emergency fund
actions.description: Releases earmarked emergency money back to available cash. Not income.

actions.title: Add an asset
actions.description: Adds an estimated asset value (investments, gold, property…) to net worth. Does not change the cash balance.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Estimated current value in rupees (zero or more)

fields.name: valuedOn
fields.description: Date of the valuation (not in the future)

actions.title: Update an asset
actions.description: Changes an asset's name, type or estimated value. Net worth updates automatically.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Estimated current value in rupees (zero or more)

fields.name: valuedOn
fields.description: Date of the valuation (not in the future)

actions.title: Delete an asset
actions.description: Removes an asset valuation. Net worth goes down by its value. Cash is not affected.

actions.title: Add an account
actions.description: Adds a cash, bank or card account with its own balance. Credit cards track the amount owed.

fields.name: institution
fields.description: Bank or issuer, up to 40 characters

fields.name: openingBalance
fields.description: Money in the account on the opening date (credit card: amount owed), in rupees

fields.name: creditLimit
fields.description: Credit limit in rupees (credit cards only)

fields.name: openingDate
fields.description: Date the opening balance is as of (defaults to today)

actions.title: Edit an account
actions.description: Changes an account's name, kind, details, opening balance or opening date. Switching between a credit card and any other kind is allowed only while the account has no movements.

fields.name: expectedVersion
fields.description: Version that was read. Omit to skip the stale check

fields.name: institution
fields.description: Bank or issuer, up to 40 characters

fields.name: openingBalance
fields.description: Money in the account on the opening date (credit card: amount owed), in rupees

fields.name: creditLimit
fields.description: Credit limit in rupees (credit cards only)

fields.name: openingDate
fields.description: Date the opening balance is as of

actions.title: Correct an account balance
actions.description: Adjusts the opening balance so the account shows the given balance (amount owed for a credit card) as of the date. Records no transaction.

fields.name: expectedVersion
fields.description: Version that was read. Omit to skip the stale check

fields.name: balance
fields.description: What the account really holds (credit card: owes), in rupees

fields.name: asOf
fields.description: Date the balance is as of (defaults to today, not in the future)

actions.title: Set the default account
actions.description: Makes an account the one preselected in forms and used when a movement does not name an account.

actions.title: Archive an account
actions.description: Hides an account from pickers and Home. History and balance are kept. The default or last active account cannot be archived.

fields.name: archived
fields.description: true to archive, false to restore

actions.title: Delete an account
actions.description: Removes an account that nothing refers to. Accounts with transactions, transfers, subscriptions or settlements must be archived instead.

actions.title: Transfer between accounts
actions.description: Moves money between two of your own accounts (for example ATM withdrawal or paying a credit-card bill). Total money is unchanged; it is not income or spending.

fields.name: toAccountId
fields.description: Account the money arrives in (different from the source)

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount in rupees, greater than zero

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the transfer (not in the future)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How it moved (UPI, ATM, Cheque…), up to 30 characters

actions.title: Edit a transfer
actions.description: Changes a transfer between your accounts. Balances update automatically.

fields.name: expectedVersion
fields.description: Version that was read. Omit to skip the stale check

fields.name: toAccountId
fields.description: Account the money arrives in (different from the source)

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount in rupees, greater than zero

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the transfer (not in the future)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: How it moved (UPI, ATM, Cheque…), up to 30 characters

actions.title: Delete a transfer
actions.description: Removes a transfer and reverses its effect on both account balances.

actions.title: Update profile
actions.description: Changes your name, opening balance (the Cash account), start date or income estimate. Changing the opening balance or start date recalculates every balance.

fields.name: openingBalance
fields.description: Cash when tracking started, zero or more

fields.name: openingDate
fields.description: Date tracking started (not in the future)
